result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations of a quantity Ω given as a double integral over an angle ϑ and a radius r, evaluated with arctangent and logarithmic antiderivatives after the substitution r = e^{(ϑ-ψ)i} z.
result.transcription:
$\Omega = -\frac{1}{\varrho}\,\mathrm{arc\,tg}\,\frac{\sqrt{(1-x^2)(1-y^2)}}{\varrho} + \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-y^2}}\,\frac{1}{2}\,\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-\frac{x}{y}e^{(\vartheta-\psi)i}}}\,\log\frac{-\sqrt{1-x^2}+\sqrt{1-\frac{x}{y}e^{(\vartheta-\psi)i}}}{\sqrt{1-x^2}+\sqrt{1-\frac{x}{y}e^{(\vartheta-\psi)i}}} + \frac{1}{2}\,\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-y^2}}\,\log\frac{1+\sqrt{1-x^2}}{1-\sqrt{1-x^2}}$ $\frac{1}{2}\;(i \neq -i)$
$y e^{-\vartheta i} = a e^{-\varrho i} + r e^{-\delta i}$
A
$[-\ldots-]\int_0^{2\pi} d\delta \int_{r_1}^{r_2} dr\,\frac{1}{\varrho}\,\log\frac{\sqrt{(1-x^2)(1-y^2)}+\varrho i}{\sqrt{(1-x^2)(1-y^2)}-\varrho i}\quad i\log\left(\frac{\varrho + i\sqrt{(1-x^2)(1-y^2)}}{\varrho - i\sqrt{(1-x^2)(1-y^2)}}\right)$
$x e^{-\psi i} - y e^{-\vartheta i} = x e^{-\psi i} - a e^{-\varrho i} - r e^{-\delta i}$ $\quad x e$
$\int \frac{dr}{\varrho} = \log\frac{\sqrt{r + a e^{(\delta-\varrho)i} - x e^{(\delta-\psi)i}} + \sqrt{r + a e^{(\delta-\varrho)i} - x e^{(\delta-\psi)i}}}{\sqrt{\quad} - \sqrt{\quad}}$
$\Omega = 2\pi\int_0^{2\pi} d\delta \int_{\frac{1}{x}e^{(\delta-\psi)i} - a e^{(\delta-\varrho)i}}^{x e^{(\delta-\psi)i} - a e^{(\delta-\varrho)i}} \frac{dr}{\varrho} + \frac{dr}{\sqrt{1-y^2}\,\sqrt{1-\frac{x}{y}e^{(\vartheta-\psi)i}}} = 2\pi\int_0^{2\pi} d\delta \int_{\frac{1}{x}}^{x} \frac{e^{(\delta-\psi)i}\,dz}{\sqrt{z e^{-\psi i} - x e^{-\psi i}}}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{a e^{\varrho i} - x e^{\psi i} - e^{2\delta i}(a e^{-\varrho i} - z e^{-\psi i})}}\right.$
$\left. + \frac{1}{\sqrt{\left(\frac{1}{z}e^{\psi i} - a e^{\varrho i}\right) - e^{2\delta i}\left(z e^{-\psi i} - a e^{-\varrho i}\right)}}\right)$
$[-\ldots-]$
$\frac{1}{y}$

$y e^{-\vartheta i} = z e^{-\psi i} = a e^{-\varrho i} + r e^{-\delta i}$
